title: Practice 8: Where to: в and на

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: В 1977 году Фадиль перешёл в ___ (мусульманство, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Fadil converted to Islam in 1977.
exercises.why: **мусульманство → мусульманство** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том дал нам разрешение на ___ (выезд, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom gave us permission to leave.
exercises.why: **выезд → выезд** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Как ты научился так хорошо играть в ___ (нарды, acc. pl.)?
exercises.prompt: How did you get so good at backgammon?
exercises.why: **нарды → нарды** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): нарды · нардов · нардам · нарды · нардами · нардах.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том сел на ___ (складной стул, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom sat down on a folding chair.
exercises.why: **стул → стул** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **складной → складной** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with стул). Declines like новый (A. anim. = G., inan. = N; the masculine nominative ends in -ой, not -ый). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Соседи превратили свой балкон в ___ (настоящая оранжерея, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The neighbours made their balcony into a proper greenhouse.
exercises.why: **оранжерея → оранжерею** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like неделя (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  **настоящий → настоящую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with оранжерею). Declines like хороший (A. хорошую). Ending -ая → -ую.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Технологическую инструкцию на ___ (теплообменник, acc. sg.) вы можете загрузить здесь.
exercises.prompt: You can download the instruction manual for the heat exchanger here.
exercises.why: **теплообменник → теплообменник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Двое из них преобразовали химию в ___ (современная наука, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The two of them transformed chemistry into a modern science.
exercises.why: **наука → науку** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **современный → современную** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with науку). Declines like новый (A. новую). Ending -ая → -ую.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он часто действовал без оглядки на ___ (чувство, acc. pl.) других людей.
exercises.prompt: He often acted without regard to the feelings of others.
exercises.why: **чувство → чувства** (acc. pl.). Neuter, inanimate. Declines like слово (A. pl. слова). Ending -о → -а.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Коридорный проводит вас в ___ (ваш номер, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The bellboy will show you to your room.
exercises.why: **номер → номер** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **ваш → ваш** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with номер). Declines like наш. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: У Тома аллергия на ___ (латекс, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom is allergic to latex.
exercises.why: **латекс → латекс** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Чтобы справиться с депрессией, Мэри с головой окунулась в ___ (работа, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: To cope with her depression, Mary threw herself into her work.
exercises.why: **работа → работу** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like газета (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (посул, acc. pl.) тароват, а на деле скуповат.
exercises.prompt: The greatest talkers are the least doers.
exercises.why: **посул → посулы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like стол (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Корабль прибыл в ___ (порт, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The boat arrived at the port.
exercises.why: **порт → порт** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: У Тома была аллергическая реакция на ___ (лекарство, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom had an allergic reaction to the medication.
exercises.why: **лекарство → лекарство** (acc. sg.). Neuter. Declines like окно (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Тому пришлось мчаться в ___ (куст, acc. pl.), чтобы ответить на зов природы.
exercises.prompt: Tom had to dash into the bushes to answer a call of nature.
exercises.why: **куст → кусты** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like стол (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том накричал на ___ (официант, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Tom yelled at the waiter.
exercises.why: **официант → официанта** (acc. sg.). Masculine, animate. Declines like студент (A. sg. студента). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ты когда-нибудь играл в ___ (петанк, acc. sg.)?
exercises.prompt: Have you ever played petanque?
exercises.why: **петанк → петанк** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Они все сильны в беге на ___ (короткая дистанция, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: They're all great sprinters.
exercises.why: **дистанция → дистанцию** (acc. sg.). Feminine. Declines like армия (A. sg. армию). Ending -я → -ю.  **короткий → короткую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with дистанцию). Declines like русский (A. русскую). Ending -ая → -ую.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я люблю играть в ___ (покер, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I like to play poker.
exercises.why: **покер → покер** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Поездки на ___ (остров, acc. pl.) стоят недёшево.
exercises.prompt: The trips to the islands are not cheap.
exercises.why: **остров → острова** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate. Declines like дом (A. pl. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  — DLI Grammar Reference Book; OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
